entries.title: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell File Multi-Billion-Dollar Copyright Suit Against Anthropic, Naming Founders Individually
entries.summary: Sony Music Publishing, Warner Chappell Music, and co-plaintiffs filed suit August 29 in N.D. California alleging Anthropic and co-founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann conducted a 'brazen campaign of illegally torrenting, scraping, and downloading' tens of thousands of copyrighted musical compositions to train Claude — seeking up to $150,000 per infringed work and naming individual founders, making it the broadest music-copyright suit yet against a frontier AI lab.

entries.title: "Death by a Thousand Taxonomies?": Empirical Study Finds AI Risk Classification Taxonomies Weakly Integrated Into Governance and Accountability-Deficient (AIES 2026)
entries.summary: A qualitative study of 25 AI practitioners across industry, academia, civil society, and government found that Sociotechnical Outcome Taxonomies (SOTs) are rarely binding in AI governance due to two structural failures: design choices are invisible to downstream users who treat categories as exhaustive, and taxonomies enumerate harms without linking them to decision points or accountable actors — with five design recommendations proposed to close this gap.

entries.title: Five Primitives for Governing Autonomous AI Agents at Runtime: Discovery, Identity, Governance, Attestation, Supply Chain
entries.summary: A practitioner paper argues that governing autonomous AI agents requires five runtime primitives — discovery, identity, governance, attestation, and supply chain — that cannot be structurally substituted for each other by conventional IT security controls; four are implemented in private pilots, with explicit acknowledgment that fail-closed mediation converts availability incidents into denial and that the supply chain primitive is not yet integrated.

entries.title: Societal Capacity Assessment Framework Extended to Agentic AI Deployers: Applied to Microsoft to Measure How Deployment Decisions Affect Societal Resilience
entries.summary: A new cs.CY paper adapts the SCAF indicator framework to assess how companies' agentic AI deployment decisions contribute to societal resilience across vulnerability, coping, and adaptive capacities — inverting the framework's original framing from measuring societal context to measuring company behavior, and applying it in a structured assessment of public-facing Microsoft documents.

entries.title: 96.7% of Baseline LLM Multi-Stage Hiring Pipeline Outputs Contain Fabricated Credentials; Prompt Guardrails Alone Insufficient
entries.summary: A controlled study of a three-stage LLM hiring pipeline (resume improvement, interview questions, answer feedback) found 96.7% baseline fabrication rate; prompt guardrails cut fabrication density by 86% but left 50% of outputs with at least one unsupported claim, while a human checkpoint after resume improvement was needed to eliminate identity fabrications and reduce JD trap-requirement capture from 47% to 2%, demonstrating guardrails and human oversight are complementary not substitutes.

entries.title: Anti-Sycophancy Training Creates Rational-Updating Trade-Off: Unsupported Yielding and Legitimate Belief Revision Share Internal Substrate (EMNLP 2026 Findings)
entries.summary: A study distinguishing 'unsupported yielding' (sycophancy) from 'rational updating' (legitimate belief revision upon new evidence) finds that anti-sycophancy interventions at both training and inference time regularly impair rational updating — because the MLP neurons and attention heads driving both behaviors substantially overlap with positively aligned steering directions, suggesting the problem requires selectivity rather than suppression.

entries.title: Debian Project Adopts Formal AI Accountability Resolution: Contributors Must Personally Verify All AI-Assisted Outputs Before Submission
entries.summary: The Debian Project adopted a general resolution requiring contributors to personally understand, review, test, and modify any AI-generated output before submitting it to development, packaging, or documentation processes — the first major open-source project to formalize AI accountability standards in its governance, without banning generative AI use, and a potential template for open-source supply chain governance.

entries.title: OpenAI Daybreak Deployment Guidance Transfers Agent Sandboxing and Action-Monitoring Obligations to Enterprise Deployers
entries.summary: OpenAI published deployment guidance for its Daybreak agentic cybersecurity tooling specifying sandboxing, action monitoring, and scoped permissions as operational requirements borne by enterprise customers — a notable shift placing substantive AI governance obligations downstream and framing Auto Mode as a convenience feature backed by best-effort classification rather than a security control.

entries.title: NHIMG Publishes Two Guidance Documents Establishing OAuth Token Scoping as a Baseline IAM Control for AI Agent Workflows
entries.summary: The Non-Human Identity Management Group issued guidance requiring AI agents to register formally as OAuth clients before credential issuance, with tokens bound to specific task scopes and short expiry windows — addressing a structural IAM gap in multi-agent orchestration where broad or long-lived credentials can be abused across an entire delegation chain.

entries.title: OpenAI Introduces Zero Data Retention API Option, Shifting Audit-Log Responsibility Fully to Enterprise Customers
entries.summary: OpenAI launched a zero data retention option for eligible frontier-model API customers under which prompts and responses are not stored after processing — resolving a data-minimization concern but transferring the entire burden of audit-trail capture to regulated enterprises that must now build and maintain their own logging infrastructure.

entries.title: RedEvoAgent: Experience-Driven Attack-Skill Evolution Improves Automatic Red-Teaming of LLM Agents and Transfers Across Harnesses
entries.summary: RedEvoAgent distills cross-case attack trajectories into concise, reusable 'attack skills' that evolve via tool-effectiveness profiling and a validation ratchet retaining only capability-improving updates — outperforming fixed and agentic red-teaming baselines on multiple agent harnesses and transferring across attacker models, directly addressing the gap between single-target model red-teaming and multi-harness deployment.

entries.title: "Conduct": Open-Source AI Agent Runtime Enforcer Ships with Fail-Closed Default and 20+ Pre-Mapped Compliance Packs for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, HIPAA, and Others
entries.summary: An independent developer published "Conduct," an open-source AI agent governance framework that enforces compliance policy before LLM or shell tool calls execute using a fail-closed default and SHA-256 hash-chained audit logs — illustrating how practitioners are building pre-action runtime enforcement tooling to close the gap between policy declarations and actual agent behavior.
